subject: CALL-CONVENTION directive
notes: The >>CALL-CONVENTION general format { COBOL | call-convention-name-1 } is the call-convention-directive-2002 row's directiveOperand column: plain braces, so exactly one shall be written, COBOL being one admissible word and any COBOL word an implementor-defined call-convention-name-1 (7.3.9.3 GR2 b). A literal or a missing operand is COBOL1911. The directive's EFFECT is the 7.3.9.3 GR1 default in every case - this implementation maps program-names one way - so the format, not the semantics, is what this row records.
